_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Represents the current Bugaboo Bee 6; Clek lists Bee (2010)/Bee 3/Bee 5/Bee 6 as one row served by the same 85510MC01 adapter. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Bee 6 (covers Bee/Bee3/Bee5/Bee6)

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo Bee (2010) / Bee 3 / Bee 5 / Bee 6 — Bugaboo Bee adapter for Turtle/Maxi-Cosi car seats (85510MC01)

specs._weightNote: Bugaboo US lists complete Bee 6 seat stroller at 20.8 lb (9.44 kg).
specs._unfoldedNote: Bugaboo publishes a handlebar-dependent footprint: 33.8 x 20.8 x 36.02 in at the lowest handlebar up to 39.7 x 20.8 x 42.91 in at the highest. Lowest-handlebar figure recorded here.
specs._foldedNote: Bugaboo publishes two folds: self-standing one-piece fold 35.43 x 18.5 x 14.17 in (recorded here) and a more compact two-piece fold 29.92 x 18.5 x 13.39 in.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (full-recline lie-flat seat); Bugaboo/Strollberry list 0-48 months

safety.standards: Bugaboo declares conformity to the US juvenile stroller standard ASTM F833; Clek states strollers on its list were tested and are compliant with the applicable ASTM standards for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: 5-point harness. No JPMA certification is published for this Bugaboo model (JPMA participation not indicated on Bugaboo's page); certifications left null rather than guessed. Max forward-facing 50 lb; max parent-facing 33 lb per Bugaboo.

recall.summary: 2011 CPSC recall (fall hazard): front swivel wheels can lock while in motion, causing the Bee to tip; ~7,000 US Bugaboo Bee strollers sold Feb-Sep 2011. An earlier 2009 CPSC recall covered brake failure (brakes could fail and roll away on an incline) on the original Bee sold 2007-2009. These affect earlier Bee generations covered by this row; the current Bee 6 is not itself recalled.

specs.foldType: one-hand fold; self-standing one-piece fold or compact two-piece fold
specs.recline: multi-position reclining backrest incl. full lie-flat (3 positions, one-hand)
specs.tires: 7 in front and rear, foam-filled; front swivel wheels with open-spring suspension

notes: Current Bugaboo Bee generation (Bee 6); one Clek row covers Bee(2010)/Bee3/Bee5/Bee6, all served by the same Bugaboo Bee Maxi-Cosi/Turtle adapter 85510MC01 (adapter-85510mc01), which explicitly lists the Clek Liing. Excellent city/shopping fit: ~20.8 lb, one-hand self-standing fold, reversible lie-flat seat, 7 in foam-filled tires. NOTE ON STOCK: the complete Bee 6 is sold out at the US retailers checked (ANB, Swaddles both $779 and out of stock) - Bugaboo has largely wound the Bee 6 down, so new US retail availability is thin as of 2026-07-05. Height/length dims vary with handlebar position (see _unfoldedNote).
